mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing clear skies near Fireman's Park with a temperature of 58 degrees and a waning crescent moon overhead.

In city news, police arrested a 34-year-old Madison woman on September 4 for a sexual assault of a child involving a school staff member back in 2019. Additionally, road work continues on Highway M with phase two of the Aldi development project beginning the week of September 7, which will shift traffic patterns.

Today you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow is packed with activities including trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music and the downtown farmer's market coming up on September 9.
Regarding the weekly police report, an investigation into a 2019 incident resulted in an arrest this past Friday, September 4.
Today's flavor of the day is Georgia Peach. Culver's is currently closed, but they open today at 10:00 AM so you can grab your treat then.
